==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I met a friendly elf woman named Janice. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Janice resembles a pink skinned elf woman with pointed ears and short purple bowl cut hair. She wears a long sleeve, pink, crop top sweater, purple shorts, and black boots.) In reality, she was a nightmare siren. She magically tricked me into falling into an uncontrollable nightmare world. I eventually managed to regain lucidity, and melted her using my Solvo spell.
